sources.summary: Residents of Gilroy, California, were caught by surprise when an Amazon data center started construction in their city. Negotiations for the project started in 2020, with public comments open until 2024, but it flew under the radar.
sources.summary_zh: 当亚马逊数据中心在加利福尼亚州吉尔罗伊市开始建设时，当地居民感到非常惊讶。该项目的谈判于 2020 年开始，公众意见征询期截止至 2024 年，但它并未引起人们的注意。

sources.title_original: Nvidia RTX 5090 ships in bizarre 8-motherboard bundle — retailers hold GPUs hostage similar to the crypto boom
sources.summary: Taiwanese ecommerce platform PChome24h is packaging RTX 5090 GPUs with a crazy number of motherboards, entry-to-mid-range GPUs, and several other components. While interesting, these combos are alarming as they show the direction that the PC building industry is headed.
sources.summary_zh: 台湾电子商务平台 PChome24h 将 RTX 5090 GPU 与大量主板、入门级到中端 GPU 和其他几个组件打包在一起。这些组合虽然有趣，但也令人震惊，因为它们表明了 PC 构建行业的发展方向。
